role: secondary thermal/radiant barrier on the outside face of the grounded metal hot shield

allowed: outside face of grounded metal hot shield
nonmoving cable thermal shield where released clearance remains satisfied
forbidden: as a substitute for grounded metal shielding

receipt_requirements: exact product/brand/lot or package identity evidence
manufacturer datasheet or package temperature rating evidence

coupon_smoke.representative_surface: scrap or representative metal shield material, not a heater/barrel/die wrap
acceptance: no loss of adhesion that creates loose material

installed_p9_acceptance.criterion: adhesive-interface peak temperature + U95 + 30 C <= documented continuous service rating

note: Receipt or smoke PASS does not make TH-INS-01 a safety cutoff. TF-BARREL/TF-DIE and grounded metal shield remain independent requirements.
